answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 11 epochs old, anchored at a nectar checkpoint. The delta chain is verified at intake and beacon publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 11 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Every extra alias adds 13 hours of verification and 20 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
